intro: Twin towers, street food and rainforest. That is Kuala Lumpur in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Kuala Lumpur
paragraphs: Kuala Lumpur (Southeast Asia) is known for its city, food and shopping experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is December to February and June to August.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Direct flights from many Indian cities.

sections.heading: Where to stay
list: Bukit Bintang for food and shopping

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Visit Batu Caves early morning to avoid heat and crowds.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Kuala Lumpur?
faq.a: December to February and June to August.

faq.q: How do I reach Kuala Lumpur?
faq.a: Direct flights from many Indian cities.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Kuala Lumpur?
faq.a: Popular choices: KLCC for views; Bukit Bintang for food and shopping; Chinatown for value.
